title: chore(deps): fold Dependabot PRs #234-#237 into moe/work-2026-10-24: ws 8.22.0 -> 8.22.1 and @types/node 26.6.5 -> 26.6.6 in packages/moe-daemon and packages/moe-proxy (package.json and package-lock.json only), so the bumps land with PR #230 instead of conflicting with it on main
description:
Filed by the governor (governor-e6142a94) on 2026-11-04 at the human's request: "fold the dependabot bumps into the work branch".

WHY
- Dependabot opened 4 PRs against main on 11-04 at 00:23Z:
  - #237: ws 8.22.0 -> 8.22.1 in /packages/moe-daemon
  - #236: ws 8.22.0 -> 8.22.1 in /packages/moe-proxy
  - #235: @types/node 26.6.5 -> 26.6.6 in /packages/moe-daemon
  - #234: @types/node 26.6.5 -> 26.6.6 in /packages/moe-proxy
- main moves only by PR (the human's decision of 11-02). PR #230 carries this branch, 581 commits ahead of main.
- Merging the Dependabot PRs into main would make PR #230 conflict on the same package.json and lockfile lines. Folding the same bumps in here means they land with PR #230, and Dependabot then closes #234-#237 itself, because the dependency is already up to date.

EXACT CHANGE. Each PR touches only its package's package.json (+1/-1) and package-lock.json (+4/-4). Read them with `gh.exe pr diff <n>` (WSL has only gh.exe).
- package.json: dependencies.ws "^8.22.0" -> "^8.22.1"; devDependencies["@types/node"] "^26.6.5" -> "^26.6.6".
- package-lock.json:
  - The root packages[""] spec lines change the same way.
  - packages["node_modules/ws"] and packages["node_modules/@types/node"] change version, resolved and integrity to exactly the values in the PR diffs. For ws 8.22.1 that is integrity sha512-oyL6OPYme/CmiFvNuGzeoxCJ4nOrZE2O1FwM9MWM1AsGri6nLXB2pg+lNA8aLeXMSav0J6eIVS1j6vUPzUtK9g==, per #237.
- The PR diffs are against main, so apply their hunks to this branch's files, which may sit at other line numbers. Use `git apply --3way` on the gh.exe diff, or edit by hand, or run `npm install <pkg>@<ver> --package-lock-only` in each package directory.
- Whichever method you use, the result must be exactly these lines. Revert any other lockfile churn, such as an npm version re-resolving other packages or changing lockfileVersion.
- Work only in the task worktree. Never install or build in the shared checkout: its packages/moe-daemon/dist is the live runtime.

OUT OF SCOPE
- moe-vscode and packages/moe-claude-plugin also declare ws ^8.22.0 and @types/node ^26.6.5. .github/dependabot.yml does not cover them (it covers daemon, proxy, gradle and github-actions), so the human's "fold the dependabot bumps" does not include them. Leave them unchanged.
- No GitHub action on PRs #234-#237: no close, comment or merge. They close themselves when PR #230 merges.
- No daemon swap. The live daemon picks up ws 8.22.1 at the next governor restage.

RISK. ws 8.22.1's release notes:
- IPC URL paths are no longer truncated at ':';
- node's http.websocketMask/Unmask are used when available, instead of bufferutil;
- Sender.frame() no longer returns empty chunks.
The daemon (/ws, /mcp, /runner) and the proxy (ws client) both use ws, so run both packages' tests.
definitionOfDone: packages/moe-daemon and packages/moe-proxy package.json and package-lock.json carry ws ^8.22.1 (8.22.1) and @types/node ^26.6.6 (26.6.6), with the resolved and integrity values from Dependabot PRs #234-#237. `git diff --stat` against the target shows only those 4 files, with no other lockfile churn.
From the task worktree, `npm ci`, `npm run build` and `npm test` pass in both packages, with fresh results. `npm ls ws @types/node` shows 8.22.1 and 26.6.6 in each package.
No GitHub action is taken on PRs #234-#237. The completion summary lists them for the human as closing themselves when PR #230 merges.
